notes: Each logical access first pays mapping_control_compute_ns as mapping_lookup_compute on the shared host compute pool (one worker per stack; equal starts prefer the most recently freed worker, idle since no earlier than the request arrival), then one ctrl_dram_issue_ns issue on host/mapping/partition{stack} whose entry transfer shares the HBM service-group calendars (hbm/group{N}).

A mapping update pays mapping_update_compute before its metadata access and then publishes for mapping_update_ns as mapping_publish_compute on the same host compute pool; user and GC updates share that stage, so the reducer counts GC updates as relocated data pages.
Drain flushes publish one after another on this one-stack host's single compute worker; the drain completion includes that serialization.
